Job 25 · Man Is a Worm Before the Most High

points: Bildad the Shuhite gives his last short answer in this conversation with Job, saying dominion and fear are with the Most High and he maketh peace in his high places.

note.label: Job 25: Man Is a Worm Before the Most High

points: He asks whether there is any number of his armies and upon whom his light does not arise, then how can man be justified with God, or how can he be clean that is born of a woman.

note.label: Job 25: Man Is a Worm Before the Most High

points: Bildad says that even the moon does not shine and the stars are not pure in his sight, so how much less is man, who is a worm, and the son of man, which is a worm.
